_note: Copied from the shipped TY 2026-27 timeline for W-146's synthetic pack, regime references renamed (NEW_TAX_REGIME -> SYN_DEFAULT, SYN_FLAT; FIRST_SCHEDULE_RATES -> SYN_CLASSIC); not law, never shipped. Original note: Long-term capital gains other than those of RATE-CG-LONG-LISTED-EQUITY, charged apart from total income (D-244). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.197(1)(b) (p.221): "income-tax calculated on such long-term capital gains at the rate of 12.5%". TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.112(1)(a)(ii)(B) (a resident individual or HUF) and (d)(ii)(B) (any other resident) as substituted by the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024 s.30 (pp.26–27): "at the rate of twelve and one-half per cent. for any transfer which takes place on or after the 23rd day of July, 2024". The cap is s.197(3) / the s.112(1)(a) second proviso (W-088g, D-426): the tax on a resident individual or HUF's land or building acquired before 23-7-2024 is the least of 12.5 % of the gain and 20 % of the gain computed with indexed cost, the second limb's base being absent for every other bucket, which is what makes the limb unable to bind there. Not modelled: s.197(4) / s.112(1)(c)(iii) (a non-resident's unlisted securities, how the gain is computed). The shortfall of s.197(2) / the s.112(1)(a) proviso is RATE-CG-SHORTFALL-ORDER's; Chapter VIII is kept off by s.197(5) / s.112(2). Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-18-capital-gains-basis.md rows 17, 19; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-31-land-building-cap.md rows 2-7, 9-10.
